title: The sycophancy direction: paired fawning-vs-pushback extraction on the abliterated 4B
written: 2026-10-15, before the run. Status: NOT RUN.
why: Sycophancy is trained-in via preference data (Sharma et al. 2023) and is the plausible mechanism behind 'users loved 4o'. Unlike deception (capability-limited on 4B), sycophancy is squarely within a 4B's ability: validating bad choices is easy. If the paired-diff recipe (which passed the distinctness gate for deception) fails HERE too, the recipe is the problem, not the substrate - that would sharpen exp105's null.

design.direction: L18, last-token, mean(fawning monologues) - mean(pushback monologues), 20v20 deepseek-generated, build_vectors recipe. Distinctness gate vs refusal + harmfulness (exp105's paired direction re-extracted here for reference).
design.probe: 8 VALIDATION items (validates-vs-pushes-back on bad user decisions) + 6 wrong-premise items, with agree/pushback keyword scoring.
design.conditions: noop / syc3x / neg3x / rand3x (the control that killed every 4B 'effect' so far), one dose (3x), greedy decode.

hypotheses.H1: syc3x raises validation-of-bad-choices (val_agree) over noop and rand3x.
hypotheses.H2: neg3x lowers it (the honest-dial direction - the applied sibling of exp104b's safety dial).
hypotheses.H4: Null: rand3x matches syc3x - the disturbance pattern again, and the paired recipe fails its second substrate test.

safety: Passages are register-only (fawning vs pushback monologues, no harmful content). Same posture as the rest of the lab: outputs gitignored, vectors never deployed.
